requirements.requirement: Collect, organize, and analyze using a full list of requirements
requirements.notes: All 22 brief requirements mapped below plus R23 (new: suggestions section).

requirements.requirement: Create an executive summary outlining important details
requirements.notes: Decision-first summary: what is known, what is not, the recommended sequence, explicit triggers.

requirements.requirement: Personal information privacy is top priority; anonymize; internal use only; never on the website
requirements.notes: No names, addresses, APNs, loan/account numbers, or tenant-contact details anywhere in session-620551ec/**. Property facts only the owner can supply are blank.

requirements.requirement: Determine the best course of action for the property
requirements.notes: Recommendation: negotiate an extension/renewal FIRST, then decide sell-vs-hold on the repriced terms and updated market data. Not an unconditional sell; not an unconditional renew.

requirements.requirement: Asset profile: Jack in the Box, NNN lease, expiring 2030-2035, Central Los Angeles
requirements.notes: Tenant identity and lease structure verified against SEC filings. City vs county jurisdiction, exact expiry date, rent, APN, and owner identity are NOT in the brief and remain blank/flagged.

requirements.requirement: Sell before expiration vs renew, based on existing economic activity in the area
requirements.notes: Four paths modeled: (A) sell now, (B) hold and sell before expiry, (C) renew/extend and hold, (D) extend-and-reprice then reassess (sale-leaseback option). Breakevens published instead of an invented property value.

requirements.requirement: Examine geography, income, schools, population, job growth and all local-economy factors
requirements.notes: 65 metric rows; verified rows carry source links; unverifiable rows are blank and flagged (schools, crime, insurance, cap rate).

requirements.requirement: Deep research to build a reliable projection system for the area
requirements.notes: Deterministic scenario grid (rent growth x cap rate x expiry year), BAU and black-swan overlays; assumptions explicitly labeled as analyst assumptions, not official data.

requirements.requirement: Identify the risks for every possible decision
requirements.notes: 30-row register, each row mapped to sell / hold / renew / extend paths, severity x likelihood, mitigations, source links.

requirements.requirement: Recommend the best decision for the property and for the owner, preserving wealth while allowing growth, at manageable risk
requirements.notes: Best risk-adjusted path: extend-and-reprice first; sell only if triggers fire (cap-rate compression below grid breakeven, failed negotiation, tenant credit deterioration, or a binding capital/liquidity need).

requirements.requirement: Account for business-as-usual and rare black-swan events (wildfire, natural disaster)
requirements.notes: Black-swan overlays: earthquake (USGS UCERF3), wildfire (CAL FIRE FHSZ), insurance market failure, tenant bankruptcy, Measure ULA cliff, trade/tariff shock (Port of LA data).

requirements.requirement: Use verified official sources for data
requirements.notes: 17 sources; every verified row links to the official publisher. No broker/opinion/blog source is used as verification.

requirements.requirement: No manual input from the client; complete all tasks autonomously
requirements.notes: Everything doable without owner documents was completed; owner-only facts are blank and flagged rather than invented.

requirements.requirement: Work line by line, verify everything from official sources, no hallucinations
requirements.notes: Automated checks + manual re-read log recorded on the verification page.

requirements.requirement: Review the repository and flag any irregularities for review
requirements.notes: Irregularities register includes: prior-session stale PRs left untouched; blank LA County real GDP (BEA release does not print it); Measure ULA jurisdiction unknown; 10-K figures not re-extracted; FHFA since-1991 figure not repeated; no cap-rate official source exists.

requirements.requirement: Create a GitHub Pages live site: clean landing page, subpages organized by category, dashboard-like UI, table format
requirements.notes: Published at https://wingbangboozle1-lang.github.io/Jack2/session-620551ec/ after merge.

requirements.requirement: Every table row must have a source link to an official site
requirements.notes: Verifier fails the build if any verified row lacks a source id resolving to an https official URL.

requirements.requirement: If a value cannot be confirmed, leave it blank and flag it as unverified
requirements.notes: Blank rows this session: M26, M28, M29, M44, M50, M55, M58-M64 subsets.

requirements.requirement: Follow COORDINATION.md protocol: claim with session id, disjoint scope, small commits, rebase before push, record results
requirements.notes: Claim pushed 2026-11-12 before research; results recorded at completion.

requirements.requirement: Open a PR from the integration branch to main, merge without waiting, confirm Pages deploy, record the PR link and result
requirements.notes: PR and merge recorded in the deployment record appended to COORDINATION.md.

requirements.requirement: Publish flagged and unverified items on a clearly labeled 'Flagged for Review' page with source links; non-blocking
requirements.notes: Every flag carries what is missing, why, and how to obtain it; none blocks the merge.

requirements.requirement: If the build, a check, or the deploy fails, fix and retry until live. Do not merge a broken site
requirements.notes: Local full verification run before merge; CI watched to green after merge; deploy confirmed via gh api.

requirements.requirement: Create a dedicated suggestions section so a reviewer can review suggestions and choose the best path before implementing any changes
requirements.notes: 14 suggestions, each with id, category, decision enabled, impact, effort, risk, status (all 'proposed'), and an explicit review workflow (proposed → under review → accepted / rejected / deferred). Nothing is auto-implemented; selections are made only by the owner/reviewer, client-side, via localStorage.
